repos_data.description: Audited (formerly acts_as_audited) is an ORM extension that logs all changes to your Rails models.

The open‑source AI Agents Governance & Orchestration framework: write the rules declaratively, Bernstein enforces them and produces the verifiable, replayable record. Free, Apache-2.0. https://bernstein.run
Audit trail with schema versioning for PostgreSQL using transaction-based logging
Automatic data change tracking for PostgreSQL
Make AI coding agents safe to scale autonomously: assign work, cap spend, enforce policy, verify output, roll back failures, learn from loops, and prove ROI across every repo.
CHAP, the Collaborative Human Agent Protocol, is a MCP/A2A-compatible runtime for auditable human-agent work: approvals, overrides, handoffs, escalation and verifiable evidence logs.

LLM guardrails & prompt injection detection for Python. Auto-instruments LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI, LiteLLM + 8 more frameworks. PII masking, toxicity detection, policy CI/CD. One line, zero code changes.
The approval and accountability layer for agentic AI. Identity → Policy → Approval → Trace. Try: npx sidclaw-demo
Transparent MCP proxy with OpenTelemetry tracing. Wrap any MCP server and persist traces to SQLite, Postgres or MySQL.

Open source AI infrastructure layer. Eight agents run on every request: security, caching, memory, hallucination detection, tamper-proof audit trail. One line of code. Your data never leaves your server.

Active development continues at ScopeBlind/scopeblind-gateway. - Security gateway for MCP servers. Cedar policy engine, Ed25519-signed receipts, per-tool enforcement. IETF Internet-Draft. 4 patents pending. npx protect-mcp

Typed backend for decisions, tasks, and content: enforced lifecycle, role-gated ratification, and a relation graph that flags its own stale connections. MCP-native. Zero runtime dependencies. Self-hosted.

CQRS and Event Sourcing for .NET — with tamper-evident streams and tenant-aware encryption built in, and an Orleans execution model to scale out. Integrated mediator, outbox, sagas, projections, and identity across 27 lockstep-versioned NuGet packages. MIT-licensed.
Third-party cryptographic proof for AI agent API calls — ArkForge Trust Layer MCP server

TypeScript SDK + MCP server for Tersign, the evidence layer for the agent economy — counter-signed EIP-712 receipts, hash-chained action and disclosure records, refunds, disputes, venue-ready evidence envelopes. npm: tersign
pod — least-privilege compiler for AI agents. Compile a least-privilege policy from what your agent actually did, then prove what happened.
量化研究预注册与证伪账本：哈希链防篡改、一次性裁决、命中率统计。Hash-chained pre-registration ledger for research claims.

Python and TypeScript SDKs for Algenta — self-hosted building blocks for AI applications. 6,000+ deterministic functions on custom Mojo kernels behind one API, SDK and MCP surface; no new language to learn. The engine is proprietary; the SDKs, API contract and examples are Apache-2.0. Siblings: thyn-ai/algenta-integrations, thyn-ai/mojo-kernels.
